aiResearchSummary.text: Formally is researching and developing a method and system for converting legal documents into structured data using artificial intelligence. This involves a process where varied legal documents related to a legal task are transformed into structured data, facilitated by a processor with hardware capabilities. The focus is on enhancing legal collaboration by streamlining document handling through AI technology, aligning with Formally's platform that enables users to hire and work with attorneys.
